overview_description.description: Doppel is an AI-native security platform that helps organizations defend against social engineering risks and digital impersonation. It continuously monitors threats across multiple channels, including domains, social media, paid advertising, messaging apps, and the dark web, then maps those threats into a real-time threat graph to identify attacker infrastructure. Doppel’s platform automates threat takedowns using AI and expert analysis, while its simulation product generates realistic, multi-step phishing scenarios to test and train employees across email, SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, and more. Through its tools, Doppel enables proactive defense by disrupting malicious campaigns and building human resilience to modern, AI-driven attacks.

about_short_description.short_description: Doppel is an AI-native security platform that helps organizations defend against social engineering risks and digital impersonation.

product.name: Doppel Platform
product.description: An AI-native social engineering defense platform that combines digital risk protection, human risk management, and email security to detect, disrupt, and reduce impersonation, fraud, phishing, and related threats.

product.name: Digital Risk Protection
product.description: A service for detecting and disrupting external threats such as impersonation accounts, fraudulent domains, scam sites, malicious advertisements, and counterfeit digital assets.

product.name: Email Security
product.description: An email security solution that detects phishing and social engineering using external attack infrastructure intelligence, agentic AI, and explainable investigation logic.

product.name: Human Risk Management
product.description: A human risk management solution that measures and reduces employee susceptibility to modern social engineering through realistic simulations, training, and personalized coaching.

product.name: Brand Protection
product.description: A digital brand protection service that monitors online channels for impersonation and fraudulent activity and supports disruption and takedown of malicious assets.

product.name: Executive Protection
product.description: A service that monitors and mitigates digital threats targeting executives and other high-risk individuals, including impersonation, doxxing, deepfakes, and exposed personal information.
